The '''Masterline-70 OcTerminal''' was a system created by [[Rikhous]]. During the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Crypt Chief]] [[Zakarisz Ghent]] used a Masterline-70 OcTerminal at the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] [[Ubiqtorate base|station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] as part of [[Gender/Legends|his]] work to attempt to recover an original copy of the [[Caamas Document|document]].<ref name="VotF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Masterline-70 OcTerminal was mentioned in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Vision of the Future]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="VotF" />
